configurator.notes: Choose thread colors, wrap style and finishing details; both sticks get the primary-and-accent wrap pattern; built to order in small batches.

verbatim: Two handcrafted American hickory alignment sticks in complementary wrap designs—one accented and one solid.
Each set begins with American hickory and is finished by hand with traditional Irish linen thread.
Each stick is prepared and wrapped by hand in small batches rather than produced on an assembly line.
Thwack exists for golfers who believe equipment can be useful without feeling disposable—and that sometimes the simplest parts of the game are the ones worth holding on to.

The thread wrapping also draws from the outdoor traditions found throughout Appalachia. Its texture and detail bring to mind wrapped fishing rods, hand-tied flies, and the practical craftsmanship passed down by people who took pride in making ordinary objects both useful and beautiful.
If you grew up anywhere near Appalachia, there's a decent chance you heard the words: "Go pick your own switch."

quotes.who: Thwack Sporting Co. founder (unnamed on site; 'Our Story' is written in first person)
quotes.text: The idea for Thwack Sporting Co. began to take shape after a Fried Egg Golf trip, where I met several golfers who shared that same appreciation for the traditional side of the game.

When I returned home, I started working on an idea for a different kind of alignment stick—one that felt less like a piece of plastic training equipment and more connected to the clubs and traditions that made me love the game in the first place.
The name comes from one of golf's simplest pleasures: the unmistakable sound of a well-struck shot.

Most golfers, myself included, went to Home Depot and fashioned the goofy bright orange and bright yellow alignment sticks as training aids. They work, but I've found if you use them consistently, the fiberglass starts shredding and you could catch a piece in your hand if you aren't careful.

BubbaWhips was founded in the cold Minnesota winter of 2017 at a clubhouse bar…the meaning, well Bubba and Whip are the nicknames of my two boys.

verbatim: Ekorre Golf's wooden alignment sticks combine classic style with unmatched durability and precision. Their special construction ensures exceptional flexibility and durability, minimizing the natural bending of the wood.
We make our wooden alignment sticks in the same way traditional split-cane bamboo fishing rods are built: six carefully matched sections working together to keep your stock as straight as possible.

Ekorre Golf alignment sticks are constructed from six pieces that form a hexagonal shape, similar to many bamboo fishing rods. This gives them a sort of "memory" that allows them to return to their straight shape.
A bent stick is hard to make perfectly straight again; in contrast, a hexagonal rod can be rotated to find its straightest point.
Owning wooden sticks is a luxury and they require some care.

quotes.who: Sebastián Mateu, cabinetmaker and founder of Ekorre Golf
quotes.text: My name is Sebastián Mateu, and my journey in the world of golf began long before these products - it started when I was a child working as a caddie in Chile. By the age of 14, I was already supporting professional players on tour.
In addition to our fabric products, I am especially proud of my alignment sticks - unmatched in quality and craftsmanship, reflecting the perfect blend of my woodworking skills and passion for golf.
This project is the result of Sebastian's thesis at Malmstens Liu, which focused on exploring the flexibility of wood and how to make the most of its natural elasticity.

ekorre.about: Sebastián Mateu: former caddie in Chile from childhood, brief pro career, cabinetmaker trained at Malmstens (Linköping University, Stockholm), returned to caddie on a European tour in 2024; headcovers made with designer Katarina Sjöstrand; ambassador Sebastián García on the DP World Tour 2026.
